'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Grab.it. Sheet side box is checked Dark; the list is Light Side. Line 57 replaces a struck Spiral with Armed And Dangerous combo (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
